newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London Evening Standard - Nov 25.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London Evening Standard - Nov 25.

text.p: Prepared for Reuters by The Broadcast Monitoring Company
As Eurostar's pre-Christmas train schedule lay in ruins following last Monday's disastrous fire, the company today demanded 10 million stg for lost revenue from Eurotunnel.
LIRA'S ERM FILIP UPSETS THE D-MARK
The re-admission of the lira into the exchange rate mechanism caused the Deutschmark to fall against both the dollar and the pound stg today.

A closed-door summit hosted by Britain's Securities and Investments Board, Japan's Ministry of Trade and Industry and the Washington based Commodity Futures Trading Commission is being held in London today to discuss ways of combatting rogue trading, in the wake of the Sumitomo copper scandal.
SCOTS WANT TO GET ABOARD AUSSIE RAILWAY

Scotrail and U.S. giant Amtrak have both expressed interest in buying debt-laden Aussie rail group Australian National, which is to be sold off in a government rail reform package worth two billion Australian dollars, or 960 million stg.
CORRUPTION SPICE AT HONG KONG'S BOURSE

Today it is expected that the current chairman of the Hong Kong Stock Exchange Council will be re-elected to a third term of power. Dr Edgar Chang would lead the bourse into a new era with the handover of the colony next year to China.
